_help: What a battle needs from its database, and how bad it is when it is missing. check: table (it exists), rows (it has at least one row), row (the row described by where exists: :ada is the witch's name, :foe_id the foe's id), readable (the query in sql runs; a broken column fails it). missing: the integrity class when the check fails (damaged: the fight goes on, wounded; broken: the engine cannot go on, and the fight ends in confusion at the end of the round unless the player rewinds). change: the name a reaction can match when this check starts failing.

needs.sql: SELECT name, element, power, mp_cost, kind FROM spells LIMIT 1
SELECT name, element, power, mp_cost, kind FROM foe_spells WHERE foe_id = :foe_id
SELECT attack, defend, multiplier FROM type_chart LIMIT 1
SELECT name, kind, amount, qty FROM items LIMIT 1

_volatile: Columns the engine itself rewrites after every query (HP, MP, wards, item counts): changes to them are not the player's doing and are not reported.
